RENTAL AGREEMENT

This Rental Agreement is executed at Pune on 5 March 2025 between Mrs. R. Deshpande,
residing at Baner, Pune (hereinafter "the Lessor") and Mr. K. Iyer, residing at
Kothrud, Pune (hereinafter "the Lessee").

1. PREMISES AND TERM
The Lessor lets out Flat No. 402, Sunrise Residency, Baner, Pune to the Lessee for
a period of eleven months with effect from 15 March 2025.

2. RENT
The Lessee shall pay a monthly rent of Rs. 32,000 on or before the fifth day of
each calendar month. The rent shall escalate by ten per cent on each renewal.

3. SECURITY DEPOSIT
The Lessee shall pay an interest-free security deposit equivalent to ten months
rent, that is Rs. 3,20,000. In the event the Lessee vacates the premises before
the expiry of the lock-in period, the said security deposit shall stand forfeited
in favour of the Lessor.

4. LOCK-IN PERIOD
The Lessee shall not vacate the premises before the expiry of nine months from the
commencement date. This lock-in period is binding on the Lessee notwithstanding
any circumstances.

5. DELAY IN PAYMENT
In the event of delay in payment of rent, the Lessee shall pay a penalty of
Rs. 1,000 per day of delay until the date of actual payment.

6. TERMINATION
The Lessor may terminate this Agreement at any time without assigning any reason by
giving thirty days notice. The Lessee shall vacate the premises upon such notice.

7. RENEWAL
This Agreement shall be deemed to be renewed for a further period of eleven months
on the same terms unless either party gives notice of its intention not to renew.

8. DISPUTE RESOLUTION
Any dispute shall be referred to arbitration and the sole arbitrator shall be
appointed by the Lessor. The Lessee shall not be entitled to institute any suit or
proceeding in any civil court in respect of this Agreement.
